hero.title: One notebook for your whole life
hero.body: Life OS keeps your tasks, calendar, goals, habits, focus sessions and journal in one quiet place, on your own server, online or off.

journal.label: Tonight's journal page
journal.sample: Long day in the library. Chapter 3 is finally taking shape, and the argument about the second source holds up. Tomorrow: the conclusion.

reports.title: Reports, made for you
reports.spanBody: A day, a week or a month at a glance, each set beside the one before it.
reports.timeBody: Minutes by category, from the time you log and the focus sessions you finish.
reports.compareBody: Every number carries the one before it, so a good week is plain to see.

day.title: A day, then a week
day.s2: Then it gets a morning slot.
day.s4: On Sunday, it's in the review.

library.name: Library
library.body: Leather spines by candlelight, a beam from a high window. Dark academia.
library.alt: An engraved library: shelves of books to the ceiling, busts and globes above, a desk by the window.

chalkboard.name: Chalkboard
chalkboard.body: Slate green and half-erased proofs above a wooden chalk tray. Dark academia.
chalkboard.alt: An engraved allegory of Geometry: a woman drawing with a compass, with a circle, a square and a triangle.

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.body: A brass star chart on navy: the zodiac ring, the ecliptic, the constellations. Dark academia.
observatory.alt: A brass astrolabe, its pierced plate of star pointers over a disc of engraved lines.

parchment.name: Parchment
parchment.body: Ruled cream paper with a red margin, an ink blot and a coffee ring. Light academia.
parchment.alt: A manuscript leaf in black Latin script with initials in red and blue.

botanical.name: Botanical
botanical.body: Pressed ferns in sepia and green ink, with specimen labels. Light academia.
botanical.alt: A fern frond, pale against a dark ground, printed by laying the leaf on light-sensitive paper.

tiles.journal: Long day in the library. Chapter 3 is finally taking shape.

band.note: Every page links to the others: a habit counts toward its goal, a finished task lands in the week's report, and the graph shows what's still open.

cta.title: Your notebook is waiting
cta.body: One account on your own server. It works offline, installs on your phone, and exports a full backup whenever you like.
cta.scholar: Rembrandt’s etching of a scholar standing at his desk, turned towards a glowing disc in the window.

footer.private: Your data stays on your server
footer.export: Backup and PDF reports any time
footer.made: Life OS · a personal study for your whole life
